column1: # WORKSHEET (er-archipelago#598) -- hand-fill `verdict` and `reason`, then move the
#   answer into region_overrides.tsv, which region_of honours FIRST. Nothing in gen
# Every row's TILE holds checks in more than one AP region.
# tile_kind=interior -- a legacy dungeon is one map id over a huge space and MAY own
#   two regions legitimately (m21_00's Hippopotamus arena is Scadu Altus by design,
#   see region_overrides.tsv). Dismiss those unless something else looks wrong.
# tile_kind=overworld -- a tile is the smallest loadable unit, so a split here is a
#   derivation artifact. These are the real subject.
# how=GUESSED -- check_region_triage says this region was a nearest-neighbour hop,
#   not first-hand evidence. surface_default=yes -- a default seed can hang
#   progression on it, so a wrong region here is the expensive kind.
# ORDER IS THE PRIORITY: surface_default, then GUESSED, then overworld, then tile.
